description.value: Charlotte & the Quail is a farm-to-plate breakfast and lunch restaurant perched on the edge of a 10-acre botanical garden on Quayle Road, serving seasonal menus built around produce from neighbouring farms and Vancouver Island. It is directly accessible via the Galloping Goose and Lochside Trail, making it a natural destination stop on a cycling day. The restaurant has operated at this location since 2010 and dishes are garnished with edible flowers harvested fresh each morning.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (25 spaces) at 24m. Total: 25 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly confirms on-site bike rack parking and a bike repair stand with air/tools ('You will find bike rack parking and a bike repair stand with just in case some air, a tire or a seat fix is needed'), confirming both Bike parking and Pump. OSM diet tags (vegan, vegetarian, gluten_free) are corroborated by the website's farm-to-plate description. Takeout is confirmed by references to 'take away goods' and seasonal 'picnic boxes to take away.' Phone number on the website (250.590.6346) matches OSM (+12505906346).
concerns: OSM opening_hours (Mo-Fr 10:00-15:00; Sa-Su 09:00-15:00) does not match the website's Spring & Summer hours of 9am-3pm everyday — OSM hours appear outdated or season-specific.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible farm-to-plate restaurant with explicit cycling infrastructure (bike rack, repair stand, pump) and direct trail access from the Galloping Goose and Lochside Trail.

Packed lunches.detail: Website offers 'picnic boxes to take away in the summer season' described as suitable for birthdays, showers, and group celebrations

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Many dishes are gluten free, all have lots of vegetables, and some are prepared with ethically raised meat.'
